Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor Gameplay First Look
Salieri’s not here to play games.

Get your first look at the new gameplay features and items coming to Mafia: The Old Country when the Man of Honor expansion releases on August 14, 2026.

► Wishlist now: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/mafia-the-old-country-man-of-honor/9NMK0JGPHHT6

Sicily – Winter, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his.

At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the volatile underworld of the Valle Dorata, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

Continue Enzo's story across two new chapters, featuring fresh environments, weapons, vehicles, and Charms. In new DLC content for Free Ride mode, team up with Salieri to earn big by taking on a new set of exclusive jobs and extreme challenges, and discover new collectibles and hidden locations as you explore.

text:
Halo: Campaign Evolved | Accolades Trailer
"One of the best remakes of all time" - Polygon

Check out the game critics and fans alike are talking about. 

Halo: Campaign Evolved is available now.

After crash landing on a mysterious ringworld known as Halo, the Master Chief is tasked with defending humanity against an overwhelming alien force: the Covenant. With the help of his AI companion Cortana, the Chief must uncover Halo’s dark secrets and fight to avert the annihilation of all life in the galaxy.

Halo: Campaign Evolved is a faithful yet modernized remake of Halo: Combat Evolved’s campaign, rebuilt from the ground up with high-definition visuals, refined controls, 2-player splitscreen co-op on console, and up to 4-player online cross-platform co-op on console and PC. Enjoy 3 new missions, an expanded arsenal of weapons and vehicles, endless replayability with 42 gameplay modifying Skulls, Campaign Remix, and more.

Halo: Campaign Evolved is available now on XBOX Series X|S and PC. Get the Premium Edition today to enjoy the definitive return trip through one of gaming’s greatest journeys.
